matter_background.original:
Herath intends to Mortgage his land situated in Anuradhapura which is under the Land Development Ordinance 27 of 1981 amended by the Land Development (Amendment) Act No. 11 of 2022 to a commercial Bank in Sri Lanka for Rupees Ten Million (RS. 10,000,000/).

Herath passed away after the Mortgage is settled and released in 2023. He failed to appoint a successor to the said land.
